instructions: Answer all questions. For short-answer and fill-in-the-blank, use only one word, number, or letter.

questions.feedbackIfWrong: A cash discount is a reduction for paying early.
options: A reduction from the list price for retailers

questions.prompt: Net price \$2,000, terms 2/10. What is the cash discount amount if paid within 10 days?

hints: Second number is days to qualify.
options: 3% discount if paid within 15 days; net due in 45 days
15% discount if paid within 3 days; net due in 45 days
3% discount if paid within 45 days; net due in 15 days
No discount, net due in 45 days
questions.feedbackIfWrong: 3% discount if paid within 15 days; net due in 45 days.

questions.prompt: Cash discounts are calculated on the ___ price (after trade discounts).
An invoice dated July 8, terms 2/10, n/30 EOM. What is the last day to take the discount?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: End of July is July 31; add 10 days = August 10.

questions.prompt: Net price \$3,000, terms 2/10, freight \$150 (FOB shipping point). Check amount if paid within discount?

options: Freight is the carrier's money, passed through by the seller
Freight is always paid by the seller
Cash discounts only apply to returns
hints: Think about who ultimately receives the freight payment.
It's a cost the seller just passes along.
questions.prompt: Why is a cash discount not applied to freight charges?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: Freight belongs to the carrier; the seller merely collects it and doesn't offer a discount on it.

questions.prompt: A partial payment within the discount period earns a credit equal to the payment divided by (1 – ___ rate).
Owe \$4,000, terms 3/10. Pay \$1,940 within 10 days. How much credit is received?

hints: It starts the discount period when goods arrive.

questions.prompt: Under FOB destination, freight is paid by the ___.
If a partial payment of \$2,940 is made on a \$6,000 invoice, terms 2/10, what is the remaining balance? (Hint: credit = 2,940 ÷ 0.98 = 3,000).

title: Cash Discounts, Credit Terms, and Partial Payments
